item.title: KZN farmer support applicants receive agricultural inputs
item.description: The KwaZulu-Natal Department of Agriculture and Rural Developmenthas delivered essential farming inputs to 60 farmers in the Mtubatuba area, as part of ongoing efforts to boost food security and establish the uMkhanyakude District as a premier agricultural region.

item.title: Northern Cape confirms first case in current FMD outbreak
item.description: The Northern Cape Provincial Government has confirmed the first case of the outbreak of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in the province, with Premier Dr. Zamani Saul announcing the development on 11 February.

item.title: Where is Dr Maja in the FMD crisis? On leave, says department
item.description: The Department of Agriculture has confirmed that the Director of Animal Health, Dr Mpho Maja, is on leave in the midst of South Africa’s worst foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) crisis.

item.title: From our editor: SONA fatigue: The proof of the pudding is in the eating
item.description: There was a time when South Africans gathered around their televisions for the State of the Nation Address with anticipation. Today, many, particularly young people, question whether it is even worth sitting through hours of speeches when a simple WhatsApp message could summarise the same commitments. That fatigue is real.

item.title: NC starts FMD rollout as locally produced vaccines arrive in Kuruman
item.description: The Northern Cape Department of Agriculture, Environmental Affairs, Rural Development and Land Reform has received its first batch of locally produced foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) vaccines, marking a critical step in containing the latest outbreak in the province. The initial consignment has been dispatched to Kuruman, where the vaccination rollout is set to begin immediately.

item.title: One outbreak can wipe out your breeding season: Rift Valley fever warning for SA farmers after heavy rains
item.description: While many farmers across the country remain focused on the devastating impact offoot-and-mouth disease (FMD), livestock producers are being urged not to lose sight of another serious and highly disruptive threat, Rift Valley Fever (RVF).

item.title: FMD a national disaster, but vaccines must be centrally controlled – Ramaphosa
item.description: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD)has been declared a national disaster and all necessary state resources will be deployed to combat the livestock disease, President Cyril Ramaphosa said in his State of the Nation Address for 2026.

item.title: Amapiano star Aymos: From the music studio to the pepper fields of Bapsfontein
item.description: Babili Amos Shili, known as ‘Aymos – the coolest municipality’ in the music world, is a nationally recognised, award-winning Amapiano artist. His passion for agriculture is a lesser-known but defining part of his life and has significantly shaped his inspiration beyond the stage.

item.title: From farm gates to great escapes: The rise of agritourism in South Africa
item.description: South African agriculture has long been the backbone of our economy, but recently the sector has started to evolve in ways that go beyond food production alone. Agritourism is emerging as a powerful force, offering farmers new opportunities to diversify, grow and connect with a broader audience in meaningful ways.
